policy: Gate A runs upstream code BYTE-IDENTICAL. Where an environment incompatibility blocked execution it was repaired in the ENVIRONMENT (pinned virtualenv, or a documented matplotlib style alias), never in the file. Upstream sha256 is printed before and after every run.
finding_gate_a_must_be_split: Only WearableDetection ships committed OUTPUT files (result/RHRDiff_offline_detection.csv, 5 rows; result/CuSum_online_detection.csv, 3 rows). It is therefore the only repository against which the prereg's Gate A ('reproduces its own committed output files exactly') is literally testable -- and it is the one blocked here. Gate A is split into A1 (byte-diff, WearableDetection only) and A2 (executes unmodified and emits the documented artefacts).
